# =====================================================================
# The Library's All works page (2026-11-08, Daniel: "Is there a way to view
# all known Sefers?"). gui/kehillah_domicile_library.gui, in the library
# body that both the domicile's Books tab and the Beit Midrash window show.
# Record: docs/implementation/2026-11-08-library-all-works.md.
# =====================================================================

# root = the player. Rebuild his list of every work in circulation
# (kehillah_lib_refresh_catalog_list_effect, generated by
# scripts/kehillah_library_catalog.py) as the page opens.
# 2026-11-10: both orders go through kehillah_ledger_rebuild_effect, which
# lists the works of the rite the ledger shows (common/scripted_effects/
# kehillah_library_ledger_effects.txt); the order is kept on the player.
kehillah_lib_catalog_refresh = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		remove_variable = kehillah_ledger_by_name
		kehillah_ledger_rebuild_effect = yes
	}
}

kehillah_lib_ledger_sort_name = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		set_variable = kehillah_ledger_by_name
		kehillah_ledger_rebuild_effect = yes
	}
}

# 2026-11-08: the Sefarim ledger window (gui/kehillah_sefarim_ledger.gui), which
# replaced the All works page. root = the player. As it opens: the works the
# community knows of, the author links, and the works a copy can be sought of
# (the ledger's Seek a copy buttons check that list, as the old Acquire page did).
kehillah_lib_ledger_open = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# 2026-11-10: the rites first, so the list is your own rite's, by date.
		kehillah_ledger_refresh_rites_effect = yes
		remove_variable = kehillah_ledger_by_name
		kehillah_ledger_rebuild_effect = yes
		kehillah_lib_cache_authors_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_can_commission_trigger = yes }
			kehillah_library_refresh_acquisition_candidates_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

# 2026-11-10 (Daniel): the ledger's rite selector. root = the player,
# scope:rite = the rite whose standings the ledger shows.
kehillah_ledger_set_rite = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_ledger_rite value = scope:rite }
		kehillah_ledger_rebuild_effect = yes
	}
}

# Is the ledger showing the player's own rite? (The subheader and footnote.)
kehillah_ledger_viewing_own_rite = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { kehillah_ledger_other_rite_trigger = no }
}
